messages:
Samir Khan: Quick thought for partner enablement: build an 'overlay bridge' kit that programmatically generates a marketplace overlay from our refkit TF modules + a tiny GH Actions/CI validator. Partners drop their name + cloud, get a repo scaffold and a validation badge. Thoughts?
Priya Nair: love the badge idea. customers/partners want confidence before clicking deploy. can the generator emit both terraform and helm overlays?
Samir Khan: yes — generator outputs: 1) terraform overlay that wires up our modules, 2) optional helm chart with a service manifest, and 3) a tiny README with smoke commands. keep defaults minimal.
Jules Park: suggestion: include an instance compatibility manifest that maps our recommended AMIs/images to accelerated SKUs (Ampere/Graviton/NVIDIA) and an automatic fallback to cpu-only shapes if none present. that avoids partner surprises.
Noah Li: for validation, we should run three CI checks: terraform fmt+validate, a quick deploy smoke (create->call->destroy), and a cost sanity check that flags > $X/hr shapes. GH Actions matrix can test arm vs x86 images.
DeployBot: CI workflow created: .github/workflows/overlay-validate.yml (runs on PR)
Priya Nair: quick UX: the generator could be a tiny CLI: redwood-overlay init --cloud aws --arch arm --partner acme -> creates acme-overlay/ with tf, helm, GH actions. Also include a small env file for secrets and a webhook sample for marketplace token exchange.
Samir Khan: exact prototype snippet for module usage we want partners to include:
Samir Khan: ```
module "redwood_quickstart" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-refkits//overlay"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  machine_arch = var.machine_arch // "x86" | "arm"
}
```
Jules Park: add a short troubleshooting section in the README: common IAM error, missing subnet, quota limits, and how to run the smoke job locally with docker-compose. also add sample outputs for the smoke inference call.
Noah Li: timeline ask from partners team: can we deliver a working alpha + public generator binary in 3 weeks? we can seed with AWS + GCP only for alpha.
Samir Khan: 3 weeks doable if we scope alpha to 1) AWS + GCP overlays, 2) GH Actions validator using our internal smoke job image, 3) compatibility manifest for top 6 instance types.
Priya Nair: I'll own partner communications and create a partner checklist doc for onboarding: how to add branding, legal metadata for marketplace listing, and post-install support links.
DeployBot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-overlay-generator/pull/12 (alpha scaffold)
Samir Khan: awesome. last ask: include a short telemetry opt-in hook so partners can let us know if a quickstart succeeded (simple ping with hashed id). helps track success rate without capturing secrets.
Jules Park: agreed. keep it opt-in and docs clear about data collected.
Samir Khan: cool — I'll create the initial repo and drop the generator binary build artifact into the PR. will follow up here with link + demo gif.
Priya Nair: thanks team — will schedule a 30m demo next week for partner PMs. :rocket:
